# Code of Conduct

LabHarness adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/code_of_conduct/)
as its code of conduct. It applies to every project space (issues, pull requests,
discussions) and to anyone representing the project.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness behaviour that violates the code of conduct, please report it
privately to the maintainer, @AIAYN-creator, at labharness.project@gmail.com.

Reports are handled confidentially, following the Contributor Covenant's guidance on
addressing and repairing harm.
